Bellows.description: Taking air-type attack damage grants a stack of Bellows (+25% fire move damage per stack, max 4). Loses 1 stack at end of turn.

Anti-Gravity.description: Debuffs have a 50% chance to clear each turn they tick down

Capricious.description: Cannot use the same move twice in a row; picks randomly among remaining usable moves

Competitive.description: +3 to whichever stat is highest among allied units within 3 tiles. Max tries to keep up.

Cavalier.description: Attacking stats cannot be buffed or debuffed by moves

Extendo.description: Physical moves have +1 range, but not through impassable terrain

Flippant.description: Super effective attacks against this unit have decreased accuracy and increased damage

Glib.description: Gets along with other sarcastic types: nearby sarcastic allies dodge better, but earnest allies nearby dodge worse.

Impetuous.description: +20% damage on first attack each turn, -10% for each attack after

Impulsive.description: First attack each turn gains +20% accuracy. Enemy attacks gain +20% accuracy against this unit

Jury Rig.description: Heals adjacent robo-type allies at the start of each turn

Low Profile.description: Harder to target at range; ranged attacks have reduced accuracy

Maximum.description: Status effects cannot lower this unit's stats below base values

Protector.description: Ranged attacks hit this unit instead of units directly behind it

Reliable.description: Massive accuracy boost, effectively guaranteeing hits

Stellar.description: Grants the Maximum effect to all allied units within 2 tiles

Waste Not.description: Recovers move usage by defeating enemies

Zone Control.description: Enemies that move within this unit's attack range trigger an immediate free attack

Bravery.description: This unit counts as brave: challenged by Roar rather than rattled, and passed over by Shriek of the Damned. Courage without Chivalric's weaknesses — or its resistances.

Close Ranks.description: +2 defense while standing next to an ally

Temper.description: After a miss, the next attack deals 20% more damage but is 15% less accurate

Hardy.description: Debuffs land one stack lighter, so most wear off a turn sooner. A one-stack debuff still lands.

Grudge.description: When an ally within 3 tiles falls, this unit goes after whoever did it

Wary.description: Hard to catch off guard: hits on this unit never crit

Loner.description: +25% agility while no ally is within 2 tiles

Shaken.description: When an ally within 3 tiles falls, this unit is Shocked for a turn

Press On.description: Dropping a foe leaves this unit Fortified for a turn

Pathfinder.description: Rough terrain costs 1 less to cross, never below 1

Stonewall.description: A foe that steps next to this unit has to stop there

Big Gut.description: A foe that lands a melee hit on this unit bounces back a tile, unless it's stout enough to hold

Still Standing.description: From full HP, a hit that would drop this unit leaves it at 1 HP

On Duty.description: Never ends up more than 1 tile from where its turn began, walking or pushed

Dead Weight.description: When this unit falls, foes next to it are Rooted for a turn

Thick Skin.description: Foes land one hit per attack on this unit, however fast they are

Gloat.description: Landing a crit or dropping a foe Challenges every foe within 2 tiles for a turn

Outburst.description: With two or more foes next to this unit, its multi-hit moves land one more hit

Grateful.description: Buffs on this unit land one stack heavier, so they last a turn longer

Panic.description: Below half HP this unit moves 1 tile farther, but can't use support moves

Tag Along.description: When a foe next to this unit walks away, this unit steps into the tile it left
